exact_statement: For independent uniform physical X,Y cubes, let C_t be a complete partition of Y into affine cells of maximum codimension k, with quadratic F2 cell phases q_t and arbitrary possibly repeated X-frequency labels J_t. The Boolean F=sum_t chi_Jt 1_Ct (-1)^qt and every physical X/Y restriction satisfy H(S_Y|S_X)<=(k+1+log2(e)) I_Y(F) and H(F)<=(k+3+log2(e)) I_Y(F). A partition into at most m cells has k<=m-1, hence full coefficient m+2+log2(e)<m+7/2. In particular arbitrary eight-cell partitions have full coefficient10+log2(e)<23/2, covering intermediate proper nonaffine four-cell collisions with no two-piece coarsening. Four-cell partitions have full coefficient6+log2(e)<15/2. Every fresh Boolean tensor factor in the fixed-k class has F2 degree<=k+2; for at most m cells the bound m+1 is sharp. The theorem retains full conditional entropy, arbitrary spectral correlations and any optional integer X-degree bound d>=1, and uses only original physical I_Y.
hypotheses: Independent uniform physical X,Y cubes; entropy in bits; original physical influence
Complete disjoint affine partition of Y with maximum cell codimension k; intrinsic quadratic cell phases
Arbitrary X-frequency labels, repetitions allowed; optional integer occupied-label degree cap d>=1
Constants depend on k or the cell-count bound, and not on dimension or d

first_unproved_line: No codimension-independent complete row entropy/energy payment is proved for four arbitrary signed affine quadratic cells on a proper nonaffine support without a bounded-size affine completion. Replacing the absolute derivative gap by a dimension-free signed structural payment is open. Full FEI and history/reference conversion remain open.
